name: fmp_index_quote
description:
Latest level and change of one market index (S&P 500, NASDAQ, Dow Jones and others) from Financial Modeling Prep (FMP).
Returns {tool, endpoint, data}: data is FMP's JSON from /stable/index-quote as returned (usually a list of records).
Inputs (* required): symbol* (index symbol, e.g. ^GSPC).
For symbols use fmp_available_indexes; for history fmp_index_historical; for members fmp_sp500_constituents.
Example: {"symbol": "^GSPC"}
